description: This file defines route handlers for authentication-related API endpoints, including OTP sending and verification via mobile and email, as well as stub endpoints for registration, login, and password recovery. It uses Express.js routing and Swagger annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: router.use
methods.description: Middleware for logging request method and URL during setup.

methods.name: router.post('/otp/mobile/send')
methods.description: Endpoint to send OTP to mobile number, invoking authController.sendMobileOtp.

methods.name: router.post('/otp/mobile/verify')
methods.description: Endpoint to verify OTP received on mobile, invoking authController.verifyMobileOtp.

methods.name: router.post('/otp/email/send')
methods.description: Endpoint to send OTP to email, invoking authController.sendEmailOtp.

methods.name: router.post('/otp/email/verify')
methods.description: Endpoint to verify OTP received on email, invoking authController.verifyEmailOtp.

methods.name: router.post('/register/password')
methods.description: Stub endpoint for password creation, invoking authController.registerPassword.

methods.name: router.post('/login')
methods.description: Stub endpoint for login, invoking authController.login.

methods.name: router.post('/password/recovery')
methods.description: Stub endpoint for password recovery, invoking authController.requestRecovery.

methods.name: router.post('/password/reset')
methods.description: Stub endpoint for password reset, invoking authController.resetPassword.
